messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw a perf regression in canary: KV cache miss rate spiked ~3x for long-context sessions after last runtime change. Anyone else seeing this?

jake: yup, spotted on grafana. host-12 shows increased page-in and `kv.page_evictions_total` around 11:03 UTC, p99 token latency jumped ~45ms.

anika: can you paste kv stats from the canary run? curious about entry sizes and namespace distribution.

maria: quick dump: `kv_stats.dump()` -> lots of entries with tiny payloads. looks like we are creating distinct keys per RPC because of the request-id add. fragmentation is huge.

diego: that matches my local repro. new key format included `request_id` to avoid cross-request leakage but it defeats reuse across turns.

maria: current key pattern (post-change): ```session:{sid}:req:{req_id}:prefix:{prefix_hash}:pos:{pos}```

anika: proposed: collapse to `session:{sid}:prefix:{prefix_fingerprint}` and store position metadata in a small linked list value. reduces key-cardinality significantly.

jake: agree. we should run an ablation: revert request_id in keying and measure hit ratio and p99 for 8k-context synthetic workload. I expect hit ratio up -> paging down.

diego: also watch for TTL semantics: lots of short prefixes (32B) are polluting the LRU. we can coalesce small adjacent prefixes under same session to a single entry; call it "namespace slimming".

maria: I'll prototype a normalizer that strips ephemeral `req_id` and coalesces small prefixes (<64 tokens). I'll also add a `cache_key_variants` histogram so we can see key-shape distribution in prod.

anika: add a migration plan: changing key shape means warmup drop for existing sessions. suggest gradual rollout with canary and a fallback that understands both key formats.

diego: need an integration test for rollouts where session stickiness preserved across model roll. TICKET-1284 assigned.

maria: plan for today: revert request-id on canary, enable prefix coalescing, run 6h soak with long-context generator, collect `kv.hit_ratio`, `kv.entry_count`, `kv.page_evictions_total`, and p99. Will post numbers here.

anika: sgtm :thumbsup:

runtime-bot: deploy 2026-03-02T11:00 — rolled kernel-selector v3.4 to canary (note: kernel change might have altered memory layout)

jake: good call — kernel selector tweak could change bucket sizes too. we'll isolate keying change vs kernel change by one-at-a-time rollbacks.

maria: agreed. starting with key revert now. will update thread with a mini-report after 6h.
